daily_averaged.method_name: Simple Daily Net Sum & Daily Average Spot Price
daily_averaged.commentary: Simple daily averaging overestimates solar-only self-consumption because it assumes solar generated at noon can offset evening load without a battery. This severely understates the true marginal value of the battery.

synthetic_weighted.commentary: Synthetic diurnal profile weighting closely tracks actual load and solar shapes, significantly improving precision compared to simple daily averaging while remaining applicable when only daily aggregated data is available.
